env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
logos run .
stdout '^recv 7$'
stdout '^send 3$'
stdout '^range 3$'
cp stdout $WORK/run-stdout.txt

logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
grep '\.Go\(func' out/main.go
grep '_logos_rt\.Context' out/main.go
grep '\.Done\(\)' out/main.go
grep 'Chan\(' out/main.go
cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/run-stdout.txt

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/ejectgroupchan

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
)

var gotRecv, gotSend, gotRange int

//logos:allow(correctness::unbounded_channel_op)
func run(ctx context.Context) error {
	ch1 := make(chan int, 1)
	ch1 <- 7
	ch2 := make(chan int, 1)
	ch3 := make(chan int, 2)
	ch3 <- 1
	ch3 <- 2
	close(ch3)
	go group (ctx) {
		go {
			v := <-ch1
			gotRecv = v
		}
		go {
			ch2 <- 3
		}
		go {
			s := 0
			for v := range ch3 {
				s += v
			}
			gotRange = s
		}
	}
	gotSend = <-ch2
	return nil
}

//logos:allow(correctness::unbounded_channel_op)
func main() {
	ctx := context.Background()
	if err := run(ctx); err != nil {
		fmt.Println("bad err")
		return
	}
	fmt.Println("recv", gotRecv)
	fmt.Println("send", gotSend)
	fmt.Println("range", gotRange)
}
